{{Term/Store|Hawk|Hawks|Series, TP, TPHD, BotW, TotK|plural}} are a recurring species of [[Bird]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 64 {{Exp Game|TP, TPHD}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Islander Hawk'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Islander Hawk'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
==={{TP|-}}===
Hawks can be summoned in {{TP}} by blowing into [[Hawk Grass]].<ref>{{Cite Manual|quote= There are areas of the land where special whistle grass grows. If you are near the grass, press A to pick up and whistle with the grass. There are two types of special grass, one for horses and one for hawks.|game= TP|page= 21}}</ref> They can be used to fetch items and attack enemies. [[Wolf Link]] can talk to Hawks, who will tell him if there are any secrets in the area.

[[Link]] is first taught how to use a Hawk by [[Jaggle]] while living in [[Ordon Village]], before going on to use one to knock down a nest of [[Hylian Hornet]]s so that [[Hanch]] can get some [[Bee Larva]] for his wife [[Pergie]], and to retrieve [[Uli]]'s stolen cradle from a [[Monkey]].

When Link later returns to Ordon Village as Wolf Link, he will be spotted by Hanch, who mistakes him for a monster and summons a Hawk to attack him. Hanch continues to do this whenever he spots Link, until Link manages to sneak up behind him and scare him off. If Link then summons a Hawk via howling, it will apologize for attacking him.

[[Rusl]] later summons a Hawk when he comes to Link's aid inside [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], getting it to retrieve an [[Arrow]] that had been shot by a [[Bokoblin]].

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Main|Islander Hawk}}
A species of Hawks called [[Islander Hawk]]s appear in {{BotW}}.<ref>{{Cite|These carnivorous birds live in plains or highlands. They use their sharp talons and beaks to catch and eat small animals and other birds. They soar calmly through the sky and search for prey from above.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> Like most [[Bird]]s they can be hunted by [[Link]] for food and will drop [[Raw Bird Thigh]]s when killed.
